title: Trace a failed action to its Amadeus call
caption: supplier-log/page.tsx. supplier_requests:read (owner, admin, agent, finance). Not an audited read.

steps.title: Copy the request id
steps.body: A failed action shows the admin's message and a request id.
steps.expect: The request id is the Velexis `X-Request-Id` of the console call.

steps.title: Filter the log
steps.body: Paste it into **Request id** (or open the URL).
steps.expect: The Amadeus call(s) behind it: API, operation, office, outcome, HTTP status, error codes, duration, Amadeus `correlationId`.

steps.title: Read the bodies
steps.expect: At most 20 calls a page; request and response in collapsed JSON views; card numbers masked; "truncated" above 64 KB.

steps.title: As a viewer
steps.expect: Not in the navigation; the page names the missing permission and sends no request.
